text:
olivia: Heads-up: we received an invoice dispute from BetaApps for $4,125 — they claim a double charge for an experimental dedicated allocation credit in May. They submitted evidence. We need to coordinate revenue recognition fix and whether to issue a customer-facing credit or internal adjustment.
henry: Do we have the invoice and the usage runbook?
olivia: Attached in drive: invoice_BetaApps_May.pdf and usage_reconciliation_May.csv. Invoice shows the dedicated credit applied once, but their proof suggests it was applied twice due to a batching bug.
kevin: If it's a customer-facing overcharge, issue a credit memo and reduce revenue for May. But May close is complete — again audit implications.
legal-bot: If customer accepts a future credit instead of cash refund, treat as deferred revenue contra entry. Obtain written consent.
olivia: BetaApps prefers a credit memo they can apply to next invoice. They explicitly asked for future credit.
kevin: Then we can treat as deferred obligation. Proposed JE (recorded in July when credit memo issued):
```
Date: 2024-07-15
Dr. 5400 - Sales Returns & Allowances         4,125
   Cr. 2100 - Deferred Revenue                 4,125
Narrative: Customer requested credit memo to be applied to future invoices; treat as deferred liability.
```
henry: Make sure to store BetaApps signed acceptance in the contract folder.
olivia: I'll send the acceptance email and upload. Also tagging tax for VAT considerations.
acct-bot: Reminder: include original invoice number (INV-2024-0512) on the credit memo and link to case ticket 8342.
kevin: OK. Let's proceed with customer credit (deferred revenue treatment). Olivia, confirm when acceptance uploaded and I'll prepare the JE.
olivia: Acceptance uploaded. Preparing credit memo now. Will post here when sent.
kevin: Thanks. Closing note: we should put a control in the runner that deduplicates dedicated allocation events. I'll create a jira for eng.
olivia: Jira created: DEDUP-388. Assigning to platform infra.
acct-bot: Close checklist updated: customer credit memo outstanding -> done.
olivia: Done, credit memo sent to customer and uploaded. JE will be posted in July close.
